activity.notes: The National Park Service states that Plenty Coups, born in 1848, had been made a Crow chief by age 28, so ATLAS uses c.1876 as a representative beginning rather than inventing an exact installation date. The Smithsonian identifies him as the last traditional principal chief of all three Apsáalooke (Crow) bands. He continued to defend Crow political and land interests until his death on 3 March 1932.
